title: The role of vitamin D in the development and progression of experimental abdominal aortic aneurysm
venue: ResearchOnline at James Cook University (James Cook University)
abstract: Vianne Nsengiyumva conducted experimental investigations into the role of vitamin D on abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAA). Vitamin D supplementation to achieve optimal circulating levels slowed the growth of AAA. Findings from this thesis are supportive of clinical trials to examine regulating vitamin D levels in AAA patients.
